Of these, the files named in results_v4/learning_v4/pilot_manifest.json (as file hashes only) = ['null_05', 'null_06', 'null_07', 'null_08', 'null_09']. null_10/null_11 do not exist on disk. So null0..2 are NOT fresh (same fixed graphs across stages, tuning-exposed); null3 and null4 were trained in earlier (v2/v3-era, flywire) records but not in W3; null_05..09 appear in no training record (only as file hashes in the pilot manifest).
